body.name: baseline-profile sequential realization handle
body.construction: The handle \(\mathsf H_{T,\rho}\) denotes the following unresolved realization program.  For levels \(w>w_{T,\rho}\) at which \(\mathcal B_{T,\rho}(w)\le T\), use approximately feasible baseline-indexed occupation profiles and, when useful, feasible dual prices from \(\mathcal D_{T,\rho}(w)\); then seek one law-independent predictable assignment rule whose expected occupations simultaneously realize the relevant profiles subject to random context arrivals and welfare cost, together with one \(P\)-independent Borel map from the observed trajectory to a connected honest interval.  The handle names this program only: it is not itself an assignment kernel, an estimator, or an interval procedure, and it assumes neither primal--dual equality nor attainment.
